query: What is the complexity of QuickSort?
generated_response: The worst-case time complexity of Quicksort is O(n^2), where n is the number of elements in the array to be sorted. This occurs when the pivot chosen is the smallest or largest element in the array, leading to the partitioning being inefficient. The average and best-case time complexity of Quicksort is O(n log n).
